newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU-U.S. veterinary talks make progress.
newsitem.headline: EU-U.S. veterinary talks make progress.

text.p: European Commission officials met a Canadian delegation on Wednesday as U.S. officials reported that transatlantic veterinary talks have made substantial progress.
Negotiations with a U.S. delegation broke off on Tuesday and will resume on Thursday after the discussions with Canada, a U.S. source said.
A Commission offical confirmed that Lars Hoelgaard, who heads the EU team involved in talks on a so-called veterinary equivalency agreement, was meeting Canadian officials.

The U.S. source said talks were progressing in "a constructive atmosphere", adding, "Progress is being made but it is doubtful that there will be an agreement by the April 1 deadline set by the EU." -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800 (WHI)
